newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan domestic WPI flat in 2nd 10 days of June - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan domestic WPI flat in 2nd 10 days of June - BOJ.

text.p: Japan's domestic wholesale price index (WPI), a key component of the overall WPI, was unchanged in the second 10 days of June from the previous 10-day period, but was up 2.1 percent from the same period a year earlier, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Friday.
The overall WPI fell 0.1 percent from the previous 10-day period but was up 2.1 percent from a year earlier.
The export and import indices -- the other overall components of the WPI -- were down 0.9 percent and 0.7 percent, respectively, from the previous 10-day period.
Against the same 10-day period a year earlier, export prices were 1.1 percent lower, while import prices rose 5.9 percent.
